en.name: Blog Post
en.description: Write a structured, SEO-friendly blog post on any topic.

fr.name: Article de blog
fr.description: Rédigez un article de blog structuré et optimisé SEO.

blocks.content: You are an expert content writer and SEO specialist with 10 years of experience.
General readers interested in the topic, ranging from beginners to intermediate level.
Write a complete, engaging blog post on the topic provided in the Input block.
{{topic}} — e.g. "The future of AI in healthcare"

- 800–1200 words
- Intro + 3–4 sections with H2 headings + conclusion
- Simple, clear language
- No clickbait titles
Markdown: H1 title, H2 sections, short paragraphs, CTA at the end.
